gates.unit: node --test tests/battle-concepcion.test.mjs tests/battle-grass.test.mjs tests/battle-view-groups.test.mjs, the named test and no other

unit.name: the director's moment of Concepción left at an hour the fight does not keep
unit.expect: Concepción is on the engine and on the director's clock: the division leaves Espada at two on the 27th, the fog lifts at eight, and nothing moves the day
failed: Concepción is on the engine and on the director's clock: the division leaves Espada at two on the 27th, the fog lifts at eight, and nothing moves the day

unit.name: a group of a side drawn with any sample, unchecked
unit.expect: Concepción is on the engine and on the director's clock: the division leaves Espada at two on the 27th, the fog lifts at eight, and nothing moves the day
failed: Concepción is on the engine and on the director's clock: the division leaves Espada at two on the 27th, the fog lifts at eight, and nothing moves the day

unit.name: the division's question shut when the army moves to Espada, as it was
unit.expect: the division leaves Espada with every family's person who went, and each is under the bank, in the line, before the horsemen come out of the fog
failed: the division leaves Espada with every family's person who went, and each is under the bank, in the line, before the horsemen come out of the fog

unit.name: a man in the division can be sent for before it rejoins the army
unit.expect: nobody in the division can be sent anywhere else until it rejoins the army, and a Host's time jump stops at the fight
failed: nobody in the division can be sent anywhere else until it rejoins the army, and a Host's time jump stops at the fight

unit.name: a hit falls when the charges begin, not at a discharge of the gun
unit.expect: a family's person's fate falls at a discharge of the gun, visible to those watching and never before: crossing the open, down, carried under the bank
failed: a family's person's fate falls at a discharge of the gun, visible to those watching and never before: crossing the open, down, carried under the bank

unit.name: the main army's families sent the fight before any firing can be heard
unit.expect: the Host, the families with somebody there, and the main army's from when the firing is heard are sent the fight; a family with nobody there gets nothing
failed: the Host, the families with somebody there, and the main army's from when the firing is heard are sent the fight; a family with nobody there gets nothing

unit.name: the account does not say why it ended so
unit.expect: afterwards the division rejoins the army at Concepción, each family is told through its own person what happened, and the country hears of it
failed: afterwards the division rejoins the army at Concepción, each family is told through its own person what happened, and the country hears of it

unit.name: the charges played at twenty minutes a tick, over in seconds
unit.expect: the fighting plays three to six real minutes at the Study pace, held to each phase's step, landing on every phase's start, and the night in camp is not watched
failed: the fighting plays three to six real minutes at the Study pace, held to each phase's step, landing on every phase's start, and the night in camp is not watched

unit.name: a class that fought Concepción before the engine is made to fight it again
unit.expect: a class saved in the fight reopens in it with the same fates, and a class that fought Concepción before the engine keeps what it had
failed: a class saved in the fight reopens in it with the same fates, and a class that fought Concepción before the engine keeps what it had

unit.name: a volunteer who turns out after the army has marched waits at the rendezvous for ever
unit.expect: a volunteer who turns out after the army has marched follows it and falls in, the coast's volunteers march on from Victoria, and the card says when he would catch it
failed: a volunteer who turns out after the army has marched follows it and falls in, the coast's volunteers march on from Victoria, and the card says when he would catch it

unit.name: the director's Grass Fight left at four in the afternoon, as it was
unit.expect: the Grass Fight is on the engine: the alarm at ten, Bowie's charge at eleven, the ditch, the sortie and the grass by half past twelve
failed: the Grass Fight is on the engine: the alarm at ten, Bowie's charge at eleven, the ditch, the sortie and the grass by half past twelve

unit.name: the Grass Fight's question left open after the men have ridden out
unit.expect: a yes is a departure: a rider goes with Bowie's horsemen and a man on foot with Jack's infantry, and the question shuts when they ride out
failed: a yes is a departure: a rider goes with Bowie's horsemen and a man on foot with Jack's infantry, and the question shuts when they ride out

unit.name: every fate at the Grass Fight falls as Bowie charges
unit.expect: a fate falls at its moment and never before: a man with Jack hurt at the ditch's first volley, a rider who runs at Bowie's first exchange, on the road home
failed: a fate falls at its moment and never before: a man with Jack hurt at the ditch's first volley, a rider who runs at Bowie's first exchange, on the road home

unit.name: the Host's camera never sent to the field
unit.expect: the Host and the family with somebody out watch it; the camp's families from when the firing starts; a family with nobody there gets nothing
failed: the Host and the family with somebody out watch it; the camp's families from when the firing starts; a family with nobody there gets nothing

unit.name: Bowie's charge played at twenty minutes a tick
unit.expect: the fighting plays three to six real minutes at Study, held to each phase's step and landing on every phase's start
failed: the fighting plays three to six real minutes at Study, held to each phase's step and landing on every phase's start

unit.name: no account when the word of the Grass Fight rides home
unit.expect: back in camp the army keeps the record, and when the fuller word rides home each family is told in plain words through its person
failed: back in camp the army keeps the record, and when the fuller word rides home each family is told in plain words through its person

unit.name: a group's men counted with their side, not apart
unit.expect: a group of a side is drawn apart from it, keyed by its own name: its own count, its own place, and its words from among its own men
failed: a group of a side is drawn apart from it, keyed by its own name: its own count, its own place, and its words from among its own men

unit.name: men under a bank drawn loading at the lip, never dropping below it
unit.expect: men under a bank drop below the lip to load and climb to fire; fog lies over the field at the phase's density and is gone when it lifts
failed: men under a bank drop below the lip to load and climb to fire; fog lies over the field at the phase's density and is gone when it lifts

unit.name: the fallen carried along with their side as it moves
unit.expect: a man who fell lies where he fell while his side moves off, and one who fell in a group that has left the field is still there
failed: a man who fell lies where he fell while his side moves off, and one who fell in a group that has left the field is still there

unit.name: a family's person hit goes on firing
unit.expect: a family's person is drawn at their own fate: hit, then lying still and carried, or sitting hurt, or running from the field
failed: a family's person is drawn at their own fate: hit, then lying still and carried, or sitting hurt, or running from the field

unit.name: every gun served by volunteers, whoever's it is
unit.expect: the pack train is drawn as horses under packs, the gun is served by its own side and stays where it was taken, and the ground the map lacks is drawn
failed: the pack train is drawn as horses under packs, the gun is served by its own side and stays where it was taken, and the ground the map lacks is drawn

unit.name: Bowie's companies given ground too small for them
unit.expect: every body of men at Concepción and the Grass Fight is laid out whole: no sample is drawn short because its ground is too small for it
failed: every body of men at Concepción and the Grass Fight is laid out whole: no sample is drawn short because its ground is too small for it

environment: Same computer: node --test, and a local classroom server with headless Chrome at 1366x768 and 1024x768.
